description: Election Commission - Declare Mr. K. A. Don Dhammika Perera Elected as a Member of Parliament
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in Parliament due to a resignation, which falls under electoral processes. It involves the Election Commission's declaration of a new Member of Parliament to fill the vacancy created by the resignation of a previous member, following the procedures outlined in the Parliamentary Elections Act. This content directly relates to election administration and parliamentary membership changes, making it clearly an Elections Gazette.
